The beneficial effect of RE s on oxidation resistance reported in the literatu re can be classified roughly into three categories. First, the RE facilitates selective oxidation of Cr and Al and suppresses the formation of transient oxides

When the consumption of Al via oxidation is much faster than the replenishment of Al from the bulk via diffusion, the Al concentration at the oxide/metal interface drops below the level required to maintain a stable Al2O3 layer. Then, rapid oxidation toward the bulk occurs until the Al concentration at the oxide/metal interface reaches a point at which a stable Al2O3 layer can be formed.
